The company

Connected by purpose. Grounded in Texas.

Pines Energy Group LLC is the parent company of Pines USA and Pines Solutions. From our base in Athens, we bring oil recovery and biodiesel production into one focused operation.

Who we are

A practical approach to resources and energy.

A food service business has used cooking oil to manage. A fuel customer needs biodiesel. Our divisions address both sides of that relationship, from recovering the oil to producing fuel derived from it.

Pines Solutions handles oil recycling, collection, and cleaning. Pines USA is our fuel branch, producing a range of biodiesel blends. Together, they form Pines Energy Group.

Our beginnings

Built from an idea with a useful purpose.

Founder Brant Borden’s interest in biodiesel began with chemistry and a practical question about fuel costs. Collecting used cooking oil from restaurants and converting it into fuel for local farms and ranches became the foundation of the business.

That original connection between local resources and local needs continues through Pines Energy Group’s two divisions.

Brant Borden   /   Founder, Pines Energy Group LLC
